implementation: StagedEditor300 validates exact supplied Project/Operation/GuiModel/Remesh identities and actual weak setup owner before calling the private native-prefix method. The bound setup owns the sole native-prefix state; factory getter aliases it. An observation requires exact receiver identity and provenance text. Missing fields remain unknown.

Conditional empty objectName assignment uses source literal fromUtf8 semantics; value is retained before unknown or present declarative hook guard. A nonempty name bypasses that setter and hook exactly.

Uncreated resize writes known attribute42 first; Created unknown/native-window branch guards retain it. Explicit min/max or absent-extra default bounds use boundedTo(max) then expandedTo(min). QRect endpoint arithmetic uses defined unsigned wrap to match native32bit operations; attribute35 follows. Attribute effect entries denote setter calls/resulting bits, not an invented old-bit value.

QVariant(false) construction remains before native metadata guard. Only known native static metadata and absent-extra/empty native property table proceed. Custom/unknown metadata and nonempty/unqualified tables retain the preceding effects and refuse.

Distinct property name/value list appends precede pending raw0xaa event. Event description binds same editor/setup identities, name sizeGripEnabled, accepted/nonspontaneous/not-posted/null-private states and exact notify call address. Unknown high event flags, actual dispatch/filter results and setProperty return are not synthesized.

Repeated prefix attempts retain initial report/effects and refuse replay. Expired setup/current model invalidates pending-event access. All native prefix mutation rejects sealed history or late/page state. A started native prefix blocks constructPageState before allocating pages or performing model/file effects.

Public ABI unchanged. Source helper is a guarded partial native prefix; root owns Session/public placement and must preserve prior QWidget/base constructor gates. No first layout allocation, storeSimNames, picking, full setup completion or public Save success is introduced.
